historical_verified_evidence.note: Distinct from live unverified 12,500 operational requests. 42,000 verified synoptic cycles grounded against Copernicus ERA5 reanalysis reference realizations across 90 operational cycles.

South America.status: PASS — low AP attributable to 8.07% prevalence, not discrimination failure

Oceania.status: LIMITATION — 2 stations, 6.57% prevalence, wider confidence intervals

Polar/Alpine.status: KNOWN LIMITATION — high elevation/orographic complexity; elevated calibration gap; risk assessments should be interpreted conservatively

calibration.note: NOT 'perfectly calibrated'. High-risk groups (P >= 0.50) represent EMPIRICAL RISK CONCENTRATION — operational risk advisory flags, not exact probability guarantees.
